cards.ex: I find it difficult to tell the twins apart.
cards.exUz: Egizaklarni ajratish menga qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsani yoki odamni farqini aniqlash, ularni adashtirmaslik.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project was a failure.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa qilib aytganda, asosiy fikrni jamlab ifodalash.

cards.ex: He's expected to toe the line and support the party's policies.
cards.exUz: U qoidalarga rioya qilishi va partiya siyosatini qo'llab-quvvatlashi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarga, standartlarga yoki hokimiyatga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: Down the road, we might consider expanding our business.
cards.exUz: Kelajakda biz biznesimizni kengaytirishni o'ylab ko'rishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, keyinroq bir vaqtda; uzoq bo'lmagan kelajak.

cards.ex: We need to compare apples to apples to get a true sense of the difference.
cards.exUz: Farqni to'g'ri his qilish uchun bir xil narsalarni taqqoslashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash narsalarni taqqoslash, adolatli taqqoslash.

cards.ex: On the face of it, the plan seems reasonable.
cards.exUz: Qaraganda, reja oqilona ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Dastlab ko'rinishidan, birinchi qarashda.

cards.ex: By and large, people are happy with the new system.
cards.exUz: Asosan, odamlar yangi tizimdan mamnun.
cards.uzDef: Umuman olganda, asosan, ko'p hollarda.

cards.ex: Ultimately, it boils down to money.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, hammasi pulga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mohiyati, eng muhim omili shu.

cards.ex: For what it's worth, I think you're doing a great job.
cards.exUz: Arzimasa ham, menimcha, siz ajoyib ish qilyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: Foydasi bo'lmasa ham, shunchaki fikrimni aytmoqchiman.

cards.ex: We're thinking of redesigning the website along those lines.
cards.exUz: Biz veb-saytni shu kabi tarzda qayta loyihalash haqida o'ylayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash fikr yoki uslubda, shu yo'nalishda.

cards.ex: It's interesting to draw a comparison between the two novels.
cards.exUz: Ikki romanni taqqoslash qiziq.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida o'xshashlik yoki farqni ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: I beg to differ, but I don't think that's the right approach.
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, lekin menimcha, bu to'g'ri yondashuv emas.
cards.uzDef: Hurmat bilan rozi emasligini bildirish.

cards.ex: The new policy cuts both ways, helping some but hurting others.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat ikki tomonlama, ba'zilarga yordam beradi, boshqalarga zarar yetkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Ham ijobiy, ham salbiy ta'sirga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: His behavior is at odds with company policy.
cards.exUz: Uning xatti-harakatlari kompaniya siyosatiga zid.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga mos kelmaslik, ziddiyatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: The report laid out the problem in stark terms.
cards.exUz: Hisobot muammoni aniq qilib bayon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq va aniq qilib, hech qanday yumshatmasdan.

cards.ex: In the end, it all comes down to hard work.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, hammasi tinimsiz mehnatga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy sababi, natijasi shunga bog'liq.

cards.ex: For a start, we need to gather more information.
cards.exUz: Boshlanishiga, biz ko'proq ma'lumot to'plashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birinchidan, boshlang'ich nuqta sifatida.

cards.ex: Their views on the issue mirror each other almost perfectly.
cards.exUz: Ularning masala bo'yicha qarashlari deyarli mukammal tarzda bir-birini aks ettiradi.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga juda o'xshash bo'lish, bir xil xususiyatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: There's a fine line between confidence and arrogance.
cards.exUz: O'ziga ishonch va takabburlik o'rtasida nozik chegara bor.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasidagi nozik farq, aniqlash qiyin bo'lgan farq.

cards.ex: On closer inspection, the painting turned out to be a fake.
cards.exUz: Diqqat bilan tekshirilganda, rasm soxta bo'lib chiqdi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqqandan so'ng, yaqindan o'rganganimizda.

cards.ex: In some respects, the new system is an improvement.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi jihatlarda yangi tizim yaxshilanishdir.
cards.uzDef: Ba'zi jihatlariga ko'ra, ma'lum bir nuqtai nazardan.

cards.ex: His latest book can't hold a candle to his earlier work.
cards.exUz: Uning so'nggi kitobi oldingi ishlariga taqqoslab bo'lmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Birovga yoki nimagadir teng kelmaslik, ancha past darajada bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company was accused of cutting corners to increase profits.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya foydani oshirish uchun tejamkorlik qilishda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Tejamkorlik qilish maqsadida sifatga putur yetkazish.

cards.ex: Their differing opinions on climate change became a point of departure in the discussion.
cards.exUz: Ularning iqlim o'zgarishi bo'yicha turli fikrlari muhokamada boshlang'ich nuqta bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhokama boshlanadigan nuqta, asosiy farq.

cards.ex: They don't see eye to eye on most political issues.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'pchilik siyosiy masalalarda kelisha olishmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Fikrlar mos kelmasligi, bir xil fikrda bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: There are always exceptions, but as they say, the exception proves the rule.
cards.exUz: Har doim istisnolar bo'ladi, lekin ular aytganidek, istisno qoidani tasdiqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qoida mavjudligini ko'rsatadigan istisno holat.

cards.ex: It's possible to draw a parallel between the current economic crisis and the one in the 1930s.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi iqtisodiy inqiroz bilan 1930-yillardagi inqiroz o'rtasida o'xshashlik o'tkazish mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Ikki narsa o'rtasida o'xshashlikni ko'rsatish, taqqoslash.

cards.ex: The company is at loggerheads with the union over pay.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ish haqi bo'yicha kasaba uyushmasi bilan kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq kelishmovchilikda bo'lish, janjallashish.

cards.ex: After the scandal, the company was operating on a different footing.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan keyin kompaniya boshqacha munosabatda ishlay boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqacha sharoitda, boshqa asosda bo'lish.

cards.ex: They're like chalk and cheese, I don't know how they're friends.
cards.exUz: Ular mutlaqo farqli, qanday qilib do'st ekanliklarini bilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Juda farqli, hech qanday o'xshashligi yo'q.
